version.changelog: Scriptless-environment guidance: install command plus the hand-rolled three-step publish flow (POST /api/v1/publish -> PUT presigned targets -> POST finalizeUrl) for environments that receive the skill without bundled scripts, e.g. Stripe Projects llm_context.

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed publishing and cloud-storage helper, but users should be careful because it can put selected content online and store long-lived here.now credentials.

dimensions.detail: Use of curl, jq, file, network uploads, and local file reads is proportionate to publishing and Drive workflows; the scripts default to https://here.now and guard against sending credentials to non-default API bases unless explicitly overridden.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill recommends installation with npx and includes shell helper scripts; no hidden installer, obfuscation, or automatic background setup was found in the inspected artifact.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are mostly user-directed and disclose public-link defaults, private/restricted modes, Drive sharing, and state handling; generic intents like generating a URL could still be ambiguous for sensitive content.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill intentionally persists API keys in ~/.herenow/credentials and publish state in .herenow/state.json; this is disclosed and chmod 600 is recommended, but users should understand the credential remains available for later actions.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifact coherently supports publishing files and sites to here.now, workspace publishing, access controls, and private Drive storage; Drive and broader account operations are wider than the short description but are documented in the skill text.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want an agent to publish selected files to here.now or use here.now Drive. Treat public-link publishing as externally reachable, avoid uploading secrets, use password or restricted access for private material, and revoke/remove ~/.herenow/credentials if you no longer want the agent to retain account access.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: Network and shell helper usage is expected for a publishing/storage skill and is disclosed in Requirements, although there is no separate explicit permission manifest beyond the skill text.
[TP4] expected: The short frontmatter emphasizes publishing, while the body also documents Drive and account-management workflows; this is broader than the summary but not hidden in the artifact.
[SDI-1] expected: Private Drive operations, scoped tokens, and persistence are documented as part of the here.now workflow and should be treated as sensitive but purpose-aligned.
[SDI-1] expected: Broader site/account administration is referenced through current docs rather than silently implemented; it expands the operational surface but remains related to managing published sites.
[SQP-1] unexpected: Some trigger phrases such as generating a URL are broad enough to warrant user caution, but the artifact frames them around publishing or sharing on the web rather than unrelated actions.
[SQP-2] expected: Creating public-link URLs is central to the skill and the default public access mode is disclosed, though users should confirm sensitive files before publishing.
[E1] expected: Drive uploads send selected local file bytes to server-returned upload URLs, which is a normal presigned-upload pattern; lack of upload URL host validation is a hardening gap, not artifact-backed exfiltration.
[E1] expected: Publish uploads likewise use server-returned upload URLs for selected files; the default API origin is constrained to here.now unless explicitly overridden.
[E1] expected: Finalize uses a server-returned finalize URL and may include auth headers; this deserves origin-validation hardening, but it follows the documented create-upload-finalize flow.
[RA2] expected: Credential persistence is intentional and disclosed for permanent authenticated publishing; it increases blast radius if the local account is compromised but is not hidden behavior.
